claim: A C023/C034 image may be exact-reversed to its source CNF only when the frozen provenance/re-encoding certificate passes; a tractable source class may then be solved by its exact native algorithm. APMA-SS rollback must restore the original image checkpoint byte-identically after a failed morph.
candidate_forbidden: accepting smaller carriers without an exact certificate
positive_controls: dense positive triples source reverses exactly and is recognized as dual-Horn/monotone tractable
all-negative source reverses exactly and is recognized Horn tractable
2-CNF source reverses exactly and is recognized 2-SAT tractable
negative_controls: general mixed 3-CNF reverses exactly but remains OPEN
corrupted provenance schema rejects reverse morph
rollback_killer_control: Corrupt only reverse-morph provenance on a dense image. The reverse attempt must fail, rollback hash must equal the original checkpoint hash, and the later exact AT_MOST_2 morph must equal a direct AT_MOST_2 morph from the untouched checkpoint.
independent_checker: reconstruct source independently from image encoding
truth-table replay only on small controls
verify rollback byte identity and append-only failed-attempt ledger
verify no source-hard instance is promoted from OPEN
